name: Daughter for Dessert
source:
Daughter for Dessert is a visual novel revolving around a father and daughter trying to run a café. However, there are plenty of things distracting our playable character…

[From [url=http://love-joint.com/blog/index.php/2017/11/05/daughter-for-dessert-ch1-released-for-free/]Official site[/url]]
translation:
《甜点女儿》是一部视觉小说，讲述父亲和女儿试图经营一家咖啡馆的故事。然而，有许多事情会分散可操作角色的注意力……

[来源：[url=http://love-joint.com/blog/index.php/2017/11/05/daughter-for-dessert-ch1-released-for-free/]官方网站[/url]]
